observations.title: Operating cash flow increased while free cash flow declined
observations.reason_to_investigate: Operating cash flow increased but free cash flow declined as cash PP&E purchases absorbed more cash. This is a corporate cash-flow relationship, not proof of AI spending or poor future returns.

observations.title: Revenue and operating income increased materially
observations.reason_to_investigate: Reported revenue and operating income grew; assess the margin comparison alongside cash investment before inferring durable profitability.

observations.title: Increasing cash-investment intensity
observations.reason_to_investigate: Cash PP&E consumes a materially greater share of revenue or operating cash flow; investigate capacity utilisation, monetisation and future cash requirements. A rising ratio does not establish investment returns.

observations.title: Net income improved while free-cash-flow conversion deteriorated
observations.reason_to_investigate: Reported net income increased while free cash flow relative to net income decreased materially; investigate non-operating earnings effects and cash investment. This alone is not proof of poor earnings quality.

observations.title: Cash PP&E growth exceeds operating-cash-flow growth
observations.reason_to_investigate: Cash PP&E purchases grew faster than operating cash flow; investigate investment timing, cash-return conversion and financing needs. Company-wide cash capex is not an AI spending estimate.

limitations: Calculated metrics use annual reported figures and may include later-filed restatements; this is not point-in-time data.
Cash capex is total company cash purchases of PP&E; it is not an AI-specific or lease-inclusive investment measure.
Free cash flow is OCF less cash PP&E purchases, an analyst-defined measure excluding finance-lease principal repayments.
Net debt excludes leases and short-term investments; debt/OCF uses year-end debt and annual OCF, not EBITDA or average debt.
No ROIC, incremental AI ROIC or valuation is calculated: attributable returns, invested capital and valuation inputs are absent.
Positive-base growth excludes negative current values; absolute changes remain available where comparable. Missing values are never zero-filled.
Matching concept sets are a minimum comparability check, not proof of unchanged economic scope; acquisitions and accounting changes require analyst review.
Tensions are numerical screening observations, not causal conclusions or investment recommendations.
Only bounded passages from selected annual filing sections are provided; absence here is not non-disclosure by the company.
No AI-specific capex, incremental NOPAT, invested-capital series, ROIC or valuation is established.
